briefing: Mythos Gates briefing: Elite: Bargain the Ash-Velvet Bargain Market: Pressure Break. Enter Ash-Velvet Bargain Market on Black-Iron Debt Descent through The Black-Iron Gate while the Gate remains Distortion Gate bound by contract clauses. Reference deity voice is Lucifer, but the player still chooses one deity from the faction roster. Objective: With one selected deity, break the first enemy pressure line in the elite-tuned Ash-Velvet Bargain Market, secure the enemy line, and deny the Hollow a foothold in the outer dungeon.

missionIntro.speaker: Lucifer Divine Voice
missionIntro.text: Every step is a clause, and every clause has teeth. The Ash-Velvet Bargain Market will know whether one deity is enough.
missionIntro.briefing: Elite: Chains Under Verdict: Threshold Sign. Infernal Dominion advances through contract pit where hellfire chains pull careless Deities into verdict lanes while the Gate tests whether power belongs to those capable of wielding it.

missionIntro.speaker: Infernal Dominion Deity Voice
missionIntro.text: The field asks for proof. One active deity enter, and The Cinder-Wound Gate will remember how we answer.

enemyIntroduction.speaker: Lore Director
enemyIntroduction.text: Enemies are not filler here; they are the combat pressure of Black-Iron Debt Descent made hostile.

midBattle.speaker: Gameplay Director
midBattle.text: Read the room law first: Exploit or avoid the route rule: ash markets that offer cursed shortcuts

victory.speaker: Lucifer Divine Voice
victory.text: The debt is not erased. It is owned.
victory.speaker: Infernal Dominion Deity Voice
victory.text: The Gate has not yielded. It has recorded that we did not break.

defeat.speaker: Lucifer Divine Voice
defeat.text: Withdraw. The The Black-Iron Gate has learned too much from this attempt.
defeat.speaker: Infernal Dominion Deity Voice
defeat.text: Fall back before the wound learns our full shape.

codex.speaker: Lore Director
codex.text: The Infernal Dominion is the source Realm; mortal myth is only the later echo. This beat documents Ash-Velvet Bargain Market as part of Black-Iron Debt Descent.

missionIntro.soloDeityPolicy: Dialogue supports one active battlefield deity; roster/Deity language is excluded from standard mission combat.
missionIntro.visualDirection: Frame Ash-Velvet Bargain Market as a combat node in Black-Iron Debt Descent; black iron crowns, volcanic glass armor, contract parchment skin, chain mantles, ember fissures, horn hierarchies, bat/dragon wing shadows, clawed court gloves, blood wax seals, ash velvet, obsidian thrones, coin/debt motifs, execution architecture.

mythosGatesDialogueRecreation.speakerRule: Use faction divine voice, Lore Director, or Gameplay Director; no playable deity language.
mythosGatesDialogueRecreation.soloRule: Dialogue supports one active god or goddess in the field.

missionIntro.soloDeityPolicy: Dialogue supports one active battlefield deity; roster/deity language is excluded from player-facing copy except legacy IDs.
